Estimated items before eating:
- Latte in a large mug, about 250 ml with whole milk: ~120 kcal. The mug looks mostly empty afterward, so about 110 kcal was consumed.
- Cereal flakes, about 40 g: ~150 kcal. Milk was added (about 120 ml of the bottle, ~75 kcal). The milk is left in the bowl, so the flakes were mostly eaten, but little of the milk was drunk. The bottle still holds ~80 ml, so roughly 100-150 ml of a 250 ml bottle was poured. I count the flakes eaten (~145 kcal) and a bit of milk (~20 kcal).
- Blueberry muffin, about 70 g: ~280 kcal. The muffin top appears eaten, with the base left. Roughly 70% eaten: ~200 kcal, ~50 g.
- Fig toast, 2 slices, about 70 g: ~180 kcal. One crust remains, so about 75% eaten: ~135 kcal, ~52 g.
- Butter, 2 portions of 7 g: ~100 kcal. Both were used, and a little remains: ~80 kcal, ~10 g.

Total energy: 110 + 165 + 200 + 135 + 80 = 690 kcal.

Mass: latte ~230 g, cereal 40 g plus ~30 g milk, muffin 50 g, toast 52 g, butter 10 g, which comes to about 410 g.
